description: §15.10.1 / §17.7 (S458 fourth round, F7) — `<each in=items as label>` inside a component with a prop `label`: the binder is a DECLARATION — it is never substituted, and inside the each body (text, attribute `${…}`, member access) `label` is the ITEM, while outside the each `label` is still the prop. Before the fix the binder name was text-rewritten (`("L", idx) => …`-shaped loop callback) while the body kept `label` — a load-time error, compiled clean.
rationale: §15.10.1 Shadowing: 'A `for-stmt` loop variable, `match-arm` binding, … shadows props within their respective scopes.' The `<each>` item binder (`as x`, §17.7) is the markup form of a loop variable.
